content: gitpeek (gpeek) combines serie's git log graph + ftdv's tree diff viewing. Spec: specs/gitpeek-roadmap.md (971 lines). Deps: ratatui 0.30, crossterm 0.29, clap 4.x, image 0.25. Reference repos: serie at /Users/DEM40PI/Projects/Open_Source/Terminal/serie/ and ftdv at /Users/DEM40PI/Projects/Open_Source/Terminal/ftdv/.
umbra 0.4.0 does not have an 'optional' feature flag — the crate itself generates optional structs. Use 'umbra = "0.4"' without features in Cargo.toml.

gitpeek Phase 1A scaffold: Cargo.toml uses [[bin]] name='gpeek' path='src/main.rs'. Terminal setup/restore pattern uses crossterm raw mode + alternate screen + mouse capture with panic hook for clean exit. AppEvent enum (Key, Resize, Tick) with mpsc channel EventHandler spawns background thread at 250ms tick rate.

name: keybind-flat-map-context-handling
description: flat FxHashMap<KeyEvent, UserEvent> for global+list bindings; detail/refs views handle conflicting keys directly (e.g. 'd' is user_command in list, scroll_diff_page_down in detail). Default TOML embedded via include_str\! and merged with user overrides at runtime.

content: config.rs: all structs use #[serde(default)] for partial TOML. Config::load() resolves path via GITPEEK_CONFIG_FILE env > XDG config_dir > home fallback. Keybind section extracted as raw toml::Value before RawConfig deserialization.

git data layer split: commit.rs (types), executor.rs (check_git_repository), diff.rs (FileChange/FileDiff/get_diff_summary/get_initial_commit_additions), mod.rs (Repository + loading fns). Uses std::collections::HashMap not IndexMap (spec said IndexMap but HashMap+commit_hashes Vec achieves same ordering guarantee without extra dep). Author struct holds date as String (not chrono). LogOrder enum in mod.rs maps to --date-order/--topo-order.

graph types: Position{x,y}, Edge{edge_type, pos: Position, color_index}, EdgeType (10 variants), Graph{commits: Vec<CommitHash>, commit_pos_map: HashMap<CommitHash, Position>, edges: Vec<Vec<Edge>>, max_pos_x}. color_index = associated_line_pos_x (lane x for color palette cycling). Defined in src/graph/mod.rs.

name: graph-calc-two-pass
description: calc_graph uses two passes over commits. Pass 1: vertical same-lane edges + branch (first-parent lane-change) edges. Pass 2: merge edges with overlap detection — finds if vertical path collides with existing edges, detouring right to new_pos_x if needed. Closely mirrors serie's calc.rs algorithm adapted for gitpeek types (commit.hash, commit.parent_hashes).

content: git module API surface used by graph: Repository.all_commits() -> Vec<&Commit>, .children_hash(&hash) -> Vec<&CommitHash>, .parents_hash(&hash) -> Vec<&CommitHash>, .commit(&hash) -> Option<&Commit>. Commit fields: hash: CommitHash, parent_hashes: Vec<CommitHash>.

git/mod.rs restoration pattern: when a merge overwrites git/mod.rs with stubs, restore from the real commit (git show <sha>:src/git/mod.rs) and add a #[cfg(test)] Repository::new(commit_hashes, commits, children_map) constructor that derives parents_map from commit.parent_hashes. Test code using Commit struct literals needs ..Default::default() for the extra fields (author, committer, subject, body, commit_type).

graph/image.rs uses ImageColors (Vec<image::Rgba<u8>> + edge + background) instead of GraphColorSet directly, because color.rs has a pre-existing raw-string syntax bug that prevents it from being compiled. When color.rs is fixed, add ThemeColor->Rgba conversion and update constructor.

description: color.rs test at line 312 uses r#"..."# raw string containing "#ff0000" which terminates the raw string early (syntax error). Adding pub mod color to lib.rs breaks the build.
resolution: Change r#"..."# to r##"..."## in the color_theme_serde_partial_override test. Until fixed, avoid adding pub mod color to lib.rs.

content: graph/image.rs edge.pos.x (not pos_x) and edge.color_index (not associated_line_pos_x) — gitpeek Edge struct uses Position {x,y} and color_index fields; adapt accordingly when porting from serie.

Phase 3B view/widget architecture: View enum (Default, List variants) in view/mod.rs with no lifetime params since CommitListState is fully owned. CommitInfo stores cloned Commit, Vec<Ref>, graph_color, graph_line(stub). CommitListState owns all data, no lifetimes. CommitList widget takes Rc<Config>. ListView holds Rc<Config> + Sender. App holds Rc<Config>, graph_cell_width computed from config.core.graph_width. AppEvent includes Quit/OpenDetail/OpenRefs/OpenHelp/CopyToClipboard/UpdateStatusInput/Notify variants. EventHandler exposes sender() method.

KeyBind two-pass ordering: override actions processed AFTER defaults so overridden keys win conflicts. raw_key_input() path on View/ListView dispatches unmapped keys to search input when in Searching state. tui-input EventHandler trait used as: use tui_input::backend::crossterm::EventHandler as TuiInputEventHandler.

tree/mod.rs uses FileChange (Add/Modify/Delete/Move enum) not FileDiff as the leaf item type; FileTreeItem.file_change: Option<FileChange>; FileTreeBuilder::build/rebuild; FileTreeState with collapsed_directories: HashSet<String>.

file_diff(path, parent, commit, filepath) in src/git/diff.rs: takes repo path + CommitHash refs; empty parent = initial commit (synthesised via git show); parses unified diff for added/removed_lines, old/new_path; get_file_diff_with_tool uses git -c diff.external=<cmd>

src/external.rs: DiffToolConfig{pager_command, external_command, color_arg}; execute_pager pipes diff to pager stdin, captures stdout; execute_external_diff uses git -c diff.external=<cmd>; {{width}} and {{columnWidth}} template vars substituted from terminal width before spawning

Phase 4B widget pattern: CommitDetail/FileTree/DiffViewer all use Rc<Config> for theming, StatefulWidget with separate State struct. State owns data+navigation; Widget renders. mutate_node_by_path uses dyn FnMut to avoid recursive generic monomorphization limit.

description: diff parser: must check for Header patterns (---, +++) BEFORE generic +/- Added/Removed checks, otherwise --- becomes Removed and +++ becomes Added.
resolution: Reorder: check Header patterns first, then HunkHeader, then Added/Removed.

content: Phase 4B view/app integration: DetailView in src/view/detail.rs uses ratatui primitives directly (no widget deps). View enum adds Detail(Box<DetailView>) variant. App stores saved_list_state: Option<CommitListState> for List<->Detail round-trip. AppEvent gets CloseDetail/DetailNextCommit/DetailPrevCommit. OpenDetail reads idx = list_state.selected + list_state.offset; commit_info = list_state.commits[idx]. Navigate_detail/navigate_detail_prev helpers query view.detail_commit_index() then read from saved_list_state.commits.

Phase 5A view/refs pattern: RefsView holds CommitListState (Option<>) + RefListState; no lifetime params; take_list_state used by both List and Refs variants in View::take_list_state(); App stores all_refs: Vec<Ref> collected at startup via repo.all_refs().into_iter().cloned().collect(); CloseRefs AppEvent restores list view from refs view

ref_list.rs: uses tui-tree-widget TreeState<String>; RefList takes Rc<Config> (not AppContext); semver sort uses inline (u64,u64,u64) tuple parser (no semver crate); tree items built with TreeItem::new(identifier, text, children).unwrap(); node symbols ▸/▾; highlight uses config.color.refs_selected_bg.0; border uses config.color.border.0

Phase 5B view pattern: HelpView stores 'before: View' field (recursive enum behind Box is fine in Rust); View::take_help_before() consumes self to return the stored view. App uses std::mem::take + take_help_before pattern for CloseHelp.

Phase 5B external.rs: exec_user_command(ExternalCommandParameters) handles standalone markers ({{branches}}, {{parent_hashes}}, etc.) by expanding them into multiple argv entries; inline markers use replace_user_cmd_arg(). ExternalCommandParameters::from_commit() builds from Commit + &[Ref] slices.

Phase 5B UserCommand keybind: UserEvent::UserCommand is countable so Nd selects slot N (default 1). In ListView/UserCommandView handle_event, ewc.count.unwrap_or(1) gives the slot. UserCommandView.take_list_state() consumes self to hand CommitListState back to app.

Phase 5 added 5 View variants (List, Detail, Refs, Help, UserCommand) to view/mod.rs. Parallel builders on shared view/mod.rs and app.rs always need post-merge fix. Refs branch merged clean, help-cmd auto-resolved but dropped Refs variant — fixed by lead-fix-p5 (1 file, surgical). All 96 tests pass.

Integration tests in tests/integration.rs use CWD_MUTEX (static Mutex<()>) to serialize tests that call std::env::set_current_dir — Repository::load() is hardcoded to PathBuf::from('.') so tests create a temp git repo (tempfile::TempDir + git init/commit) and change cwd exclusively. cfg(test) Repository::new() is NOT available to integration tests (only unit tests inside the lib).

description: File scope set to tests/integration.rs only, but task spec also required cargo clippy fixes in src/ files. 17 warnings across src/config.rs, src/graph/calc.rs, src/graph/image.rs, src/keybind.rs, src/tree/mod.rs, src/view/mod.rs, src/view/user_command.rs, src/widget/diff_viewer.rs, src/widget/file_tree.rs — all unreachable within scope.
resolution: Reported blocker to parent via worker_done mail. Integration tests delivered; clippy requires scope expansion or separate task.

content: Phase 6C clippy pattern: &mut Vec<T> fn params that only index/iterate (no push/resize) should use &mut [T] instead. Functions that actually call .push() on the outer Vec must keep &mut Vec<T>. Applies to all pending/lane_state helper fns in graph/calc.rs and tree/file_tree helpers.
Phase 6C: strip_prefix pattern — when checking line.starts_with('+') then using line[1..], clippy flags as manual_strip. Use if let Some(stripped) = line.strip_prefix('+') { ... } instead.

Phase 6A LRU diff cache: thread_local! RefCell<DiffLruCache> in src/view/detail.rs keyed by (commit_hash, filepath). DetailView recreated per commit so cache must live outside it; thread_local is correct for single-threaded TUI. Capacity 64. VecDeque-based O(n) LRU sufficient for small capacity.

name: rayon-parallel-graph-rendering
description: build_graph_image uses rayon par_iter over unique (pos_x, edges) HashSet; preload_range() computes (CommitHash, String) pairs in parallel by capturing &Graph + &ImageParams + &DrawingPixels as shared refs before par_iter — all types are Send+Sync via standard collections

content: DiffCache in src/widget/commit_list.rs: HashMap<(CommitHash,String),String> + VecDeque for FIFO eviction, capacity=64, keyed by (commit_hash, filepath); field CommitListState.diff_cache provides LRU diff content to detail view; no-op on duplicate insert; get() uses .clone() for key lookup

Phase 6B UX polish: RunResult enum (Quit|Refresh) returned from App::run; lib::run loops on Refresh preserving selected CommitHash; App::new takes restore_hash: Option<&CommitHash> + use_text_graph: bool; terminal_supports_images() checks KITTY_WINDOW_ID / TERM=xterm-ghostty / TERM_PROGRAM=iTerm.app

Phase 6B text graph: graph/text.rs render_text_row(graph, hash) -> String maps EdgeType to box-drawing chars (│─╵╷╴╶╮╯╭╰); commit node = ●; exported via graph/mod.rs as pub use text::render_text_row; populated in CommitInfo.graph_line when use_text_graph=true

Phase 6B refresh: UserEvent::Refresh (already in keybind.rs, bound to shift-R) sends AppEvent::Refresh; on Refresh, App::run takes list_state or saved_list_state to capture selected hash, returns RunResult::Refresh(hash); Resize arm uses continue to trigger re-render

Phase 6 (final) added: rayon parallel graph image preloading (image.rs), LRU diff cache (detail.rs), text-based Unicode graph fallback (graph/text.rs), Refresh key (Shift-R reloads repo preserving selection), 27 new tests (11 integration + 16 unit), 17 clippy warnings fixed. All 6 phases complete. Known minor: EventHandler thread leak on refresh (old poll threads not joined).

description: Previous builder wrote README with wrong CLI: included [PATH] argument that doesn't exist, used --date-order/--topo-order instead of actual --order/--graph-width/--graph-style/--protocol.
resolution: Read src/main.rs for CLI, src/external.rs for template vars ({{target_hash}} etc.), assets/default-keybind.toml for default keys. Detail view scroll/nav bindings have no defaults - must be user-configured.

content: gpeek CLI has NO path argument - always operates on CWD. Options: --order (chrono|topo), --graph-width (auto|double|single), --graph-style (rounded|angular), --protocol (auto|iterm|kitty). User command template vars: {{target_hash}}, {{first_parent_hash}}, {{parent_hashes}}, {{refs}}, {{branches}}, {{remote_branches}}, {{tags}}, {{area_width}}, {{area_height}}.

description: GraphImageManager was never instantiated in App::new() when use_text_graph=false; graph_line was always String::new()
resolution: Create GraphImageManager with preload=true before the commits iterator, call encoded_image(hash) in the closure; add theme_color_to_rgba() using ThemeColor.0 field to get ratatui Color then match to image::Rgba

content: detail.rs diff scroll: ScrollDown/Up/HalfPageDown/HalfPageUp/PageDown/PageUp UserEvents must be handled explicitly in DetailView::handle_event(); they are NOT forwarded automatically from the global keybind system. Without these arms the natural ctrl-e/y/d/u/f/b keys do nothing in detail view.

detail.rs metadata scroll: DetailView.metadata_scroll_y scrolls commit body in render_header() when file_changes.is_empty(). header_height() must account for indicator line (+1 when body_count > 5). ScrollDown/Up route to metadata scroll vs diff scroll based on whether file_changes is empty.

name: clear-frame-view-transition
description: On view transitions, set AppStatus.clear=true and call clear_images(). The render() method checks this flag first: emits ratatui Clear widget over f.area(), calls clear_images() again, resets flag, returns early. Next frame draws new view on clean canvas. Prevents ratatui diff-based renderer from leaving stale text/images from previous view.
